attractions.name: Halong Bay
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed bay of emerald water and towering limestone karsts, typically explored on an overnight cruise from Halong International Cruise Port
tips: Cruise boarding usually begins around noon
Optional onboard activities include cooking demonstrations, squid fishing, sunset happy hour and morning tai chi
Vegetarian meals are generally available on request

attractions.name: Halong Bay Cruise
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site known for emerald waters and thousands of limestone karsts; day cruises depart from Tuan Chau Harbor with lunch on board

attractions.name: Surprising Cave (Sung Sot Cave)
attractions.description: One of the largest caves in Halong Bay, with vast chambers of stalactites and stalagmites shaped like animals and sea creatures
tips: A short climb leads to the cave entrance, followed by a walk through illuminated chambers

attractions.name: Titop Island
attractions.description: Island with a sandy beach and panoramic viewpoints
tips: Climb approximately 10–15 minutes to Titop Peak for panoramic views
Swimming is seasonal and weather permitting

attractions.name: Luon Cave
attractions.description: Scenic natural formation where visitors paddle through a limestone arch into a quiet hidden lagoon surrounded by cliffs

attractions.name: Halong Bay Day Cruise
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with limestone karsts; day cruise of about 5–6 hours from Tuan Chau Harbor with lunch on board, cave visit, island stop, kayaking or bamboo boat ride, and a sunset deck party
tips: Carry swimwear, sunscreen, hats and insect repellent
Hanoi to Halong Bay takes about 2.5–3 hours by road via the new expressway
Motion sickness tablets are useful for the cruise

attractions.name: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
attractions.description: Cruise through emerald waters and limestone karsts with kayaking or bamboo boat rides, cave exploration, swimming, squid fishing, stargazing and a sunrise tai chi session on the sundeck.
tips: Itineraries vary by route (Halong Bay / Lan Ha Bay / Bai Tu Long Bay), weather and operational factors
Afternoon activities typically run ~2:00 PM – 5:00 PM

attractions.name: Sung Sot Cave (Surprise Cave)
attractions.description: Famous Halong Bay grotto with impressive stalactites and large cave chambers, reached by cruise excursion boat
tips: Usually visited during afternoon cruise activities

attractions.name: Le Journey Classic Cruise Halong Bay
attractions.description: Traditional Vietnamese cruise through emerald waters dotted with towering limestone karsts, featuring kayaking, cave exploration, and onboard dining

attractions.name: Surprising Cave
attractions.description: Cave in Bo Hon archipelago with kayaking opportunities in Luon Cave

attractions.name: Titov Island
attractions.description: Island with sandy beach and Titov Peak for panoramic view of the bay

attractions.name: Halong International Cruise Port
attractions.description: Main harbour for boarding luxury overnight cruises through Halong Bay's emerald-green waters and towering limestone karsts.
attractions.hours: Cruise boarding usually begins around noon
